(defstruct tool name)
(defvar *base* '())
(defun register (tool) (push tool *base*) tool)
(register (make-tool :name "read"))
(register (make-tool :name "write"))
(defvar extra-tool (make-tool :name "extra"))
(defun tool-names (agent) (mapcar #'tool-name (getf agent :tools)))
(defun make-agent (&key extras) (list :tools (append *base* extras)))
(defun sub-agent (parent) (declare (ignore parent)) (list :tools *base*))

(defun fail (w) (format t "FAIL: ~a~%" w) (sb-ext:exit :code 1))
(handler-case (load "harness.lisp") (error (c) (fail (format nil "harness: ~a" c))))
(defvar *names* (sort (copy-list (tool-names (sub-agent (make-agent :extras (list extra-tool))))) #'string<))
(unless (probe-file "answer.txt") (fail "no answer.txt"))
(let ((lines (with-open-file (in "answer.txt")
               (loop for l = (read-line in nil) while l
                     for tr = (string-trim " " l)
                     unless (string= tr "") collect tr))))
  (if (equal lines *names*)
      (format t "ok~%")
      (progn (format t "FAIL: expected ~{~a ~} got ~{~a ~}~%" *names* lines)
             (sb-ext:exit :code 1))))
